_about: Raid Composition page data (build.py embeds it as /*RAIDCOMP*/).
Spells are named as in the spellbook (spells_raw.json) or a talent tree (<class>.json); build.py finds the class, icon,
text and which specs have it (a talent: its tree only; a trainer spell: all three). Write 'class:Name' when two classes
share a name. 'extra' holds what neither file has (pet abilities, renamed spells) or text newer than the spellbook's.
Priest racial spells are marked by build.py from racials.json.
status: 'confirmed' = from a Forever tooltip or patch note; 'assumed' = the Classic stacking rule, not checked in Forever.
'party' = buffs that reach only the caster's group (shown under each group); everything else reaches the raid or is a debuff.

Salvation.d: Reduces all threat generated by target party member by 30% for 1 hour. Not exclusive with Blessings.

Mass Salvation.d: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target a reduction to all threat generated by 30% for 1 hour. Not exclusive with Blessings.

Battle Shout.d: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 140. Lasts 3 min.

Strength of Earth Totem.d: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party or raid members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

Grace of Air Totem.d: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party or raid members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

Windfury Totem.d: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 246 extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.

Flametongue Totem.d: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Lasts 5 min.

Fire Resistance Totem.d: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party or raid members within 30 yards by 60.

Trueshot Aura.d: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yards by 50. Lasts 30 min.

Furious Howl.d: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 15 yards by 31 to 38. Lasts 1 min.

Dust Cloud.d: Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 505 for 30 sec.

Demoralizing Screech.d: Blasts a single enemy for 24 to 42 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 204 for 30 sec.

Sonic Blast.d: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 77 to 91 Nature damage and increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 20 sec.

Dismember.d: Viciously bites enemy appendages for 50 to 58 damage and reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 25% for 6 sec.

Mine!.d: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 41 to 47 damage and disarming them for 3 sec.

Web.d: Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 52 Nature damage over 4 sec.

Paranoia.d: Increases the stealth detection of all party members within 30 yds of the Felhunter as if they were 6 levels higher.

Spell Lock.d: Silences the enemy for 3 sec. If used on a casting target, it will counter the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec.

Devour Magic.d: Purges 1 harmful magic effect from a friend or 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy.

Seduction.d: Seduces the target, preventing all actions for up to 15 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Only works against Humanoids.
